task: Rework the codemie-ui nested tool-call confirmation to the new backend contract: drop Thought.decision and pending_tool_call, collect Allow/Deny for every waiting step client-side, send one batch resume with local Allowed/Denied state on send, shrink the resume error table, drop the disabled-until-stream-ends rule, and update tests.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches the types (conversation, chatGeneration types), the chatGeneration store (resumeToolCall, _prepareRequestData, RESUME_ERROR_ACTIONS and five settle sites, _handleThought merge), two utils (thoughtTree, chatHelpers) and four components (thoughtView, ChatAiMessage, ThoughtHeader, ChatPrompt). All inside one subsystem, the chat confirmation path, so L rather than XL. ThoughtHeader.getThoughtStatus is shared with the workflow drawer, but the change only removes decision branches, so the shared-utility bump was not applied.

The closest pattern is the current one-request-per-click resume path through _sendRequest, which stays in place. Nothing exists yet for 'decided locally but not sent' state outside Thought.decision, for undoing it on a restore-type error, or for scrolling to the next undecided step. The stream=null additions in _handleStreamResponse apply to every chat. The new error rows (404, two 409s, 422s) fit the existing resumeErrors test template, so the edge-case bump was not applied.

About 9 source files plus about 9 test files and the toolCallResume fixture module must be reworked: the old contract is asserted in the decision field, the {action, thought_id} body, the one-at-a-time S5 chunk, the disabled-while-stream tests, 'Not run' and the old 409 texts. Roughly 19 modified and 1-2 new (a batch-pause fixture) across src/types, src/store, src/utils, src/components and src/pages. That is above the L example (8 files) but has no structural or foundation impact, so XL rather than XXL.

The handoff, the backend spec and four user decisions settle the contract. Two questions are still open: where the local decided state lives (and how restore undoes it), and whether the all-chats stream=null additions stay now that rule 4 is dropped. Total 20 is at the M/L boundary; lean-higher does not apply (neither Technical Risk nor Component Scope is at XL), so it stays M. The calibration examples agree: below the L example (22), above the M example (15).
